title: Public docs before/after observation note
summary: Produce a JSON observation note for a labelled public documentation change. Synthetic fixture only — no private customer material.

objectiveCriteria.description: sourceUrl must be an https URL
observedAt must look like an ISO-8601 timestamp
summary must be a short string

subjectiveCriteria.description: A human operator finds the summary useful enough to keep
subjectiveCriteria.reviewHint: Unresolved until a human marks keep/discard; walkthrough never auto-passes subjective.

bounds.notes: No custody, escrow, payment, or invented demand. Offline demo only.
